summary: The default params serializer now percent-encodes '[' and ']' (%5B/%5D) in query values instead of leaving them literal
isCancel's type guard narrows to CanceledError<T> instead of the old Cancel type (type-level return-type change; the CommonJS typings followed in 1.17.0)
Under Bun the package exports now resolve to the Node.js build (http adapter) instead of the browser build (xhr/fetch adapters)

Config merging and the adapters read only own properties of config objects (and from 1.15.2 produce null-prototype configs), so values inherited through a config's prototype chain are ignored where they used to be honored; tightened further in 1.15.2, 1.17.0, 1.18.0 and 1.20.0
The fetch adapter now enforces maxBodyLength and maxContentLength, which it silently ignored before 1.16.0
Requests sent through a proxy keep a user-supplied Host header instead of having it overwritten by the proxy path
Basic-auth credentials embedded in the request URL are percent-decoded before use (https://user:p%40ss@host sends p@ss) instead of being sent as written
Protocol detection (parseProtocol) now requires a colon after the scheme, so loosely formed protocol strings that used to match no longer do
Non-ASCII strings are encoded with a spec-correct UTF-8 encoder instead of the deprecated unescape(), so output bytes can differ for non-ASCII input
The fetch adapter now sends a default User-Agent: axios/<version> header where the runtime allows it, matching the http adapter, where it sent none before
The Node http adapter strips caller-specified sensitive headers (Authorization, API-key style headers) when a redirect goes to another origin instead of forwarding them
http:/https: URLs missing the // (https:example.com, http:/example.com) now reject with AxiosError ERR_INVALID_URL instead of being silently normalised and sent
FormData serialisation and formDataToJSON now stop at a default nesting depth of 100 and throw ERR_FORM_DATA_DEPTH_EXCEEDED beyond it, where nesting was unbounded before
NO_PROXY matching now treats 0.0.0.0 and IPv6 :: (and their compressed forms) as local addresses that bypass the proxy, where they previously did not match
HttpStatusCode.PayloadTooLarge (413) is deprecated in favor of the new HttpStatusCode.ContentTooLarge
HttpStatusCode.UnprocessableEntity (422) is deprecated in favor of the new HttpStatusCode.UnprocessableContent
With the fetch adapter maxRedirects: 0 now prevents redirects from being followed (manual redirect mode, exposing the 3xx or an opaque redirect) instead of being ignored
NO_PROXY entries now accept IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR ranges, so 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 bypass the proxy for every destination where such entries previously matched nothing
data: URIs whose media type contains extra slash separators now reject with ERR_INVALID_URL instead of being parsed
